selection: usable_screen=true, status=ok, flux_units_validated=true, finite u1960/v1960 in corrected_record_screen.csv.gz
aggregation: One pair per entity_id and instrument pair; coordinate-wise medians of eligible records within each instrument.
interpretation: Selected-sample descriptive differences, not instrument systematic-bias estimates. Unresolved units are excluded. Duplicate archive observations, shared photometric calibration, differing epochs, uncertain positional identities and sample selection prevent treating pairs as independent error estimates. No population false-discovery rate is estimated.
